description: This file contains type guard functions and utility functions for identifying and working with various Excalidraw element types, such as images, frames, arrows, lines, and other drawable elements.

methods.name: isInitializedImageElement
methods.description: Type guard to check if an element is an initialized image element with a fileId.

methods.name: isImageElement
methods.description: Type guard to check if an element is an image element.

methods.name: isEmbeddableElement
methods.description: Type guard to check if an element is embeddable.

methods.name: isIframeElement
methods.description: Type guard to check if an element is an iframe.

methods.name: isIframeLikeElement
methods.description: Type guard to check if an element is iframe or embeddable.

methods.name: isTextElement
methods.description: Type guard to check if an element is a text element.

methods.name: isFrameElement
methods.description: Type guard to check if an element is a frame.

methods.name: isMagicFrameElement
methods.description: Type guard to check if an element is a magic frame.

methods.name: isFrameLikeElement
methods.description: Type guard to check if an element is a frame or magic frame.

methods.name: isFreeDrawElement
methods.description: Type guard to check if an element is a free draw element.

methods.name: isFreeDrawElementType
methods.description: Checks if an element type is 'freedraw'.

methods.name: isLinearElement
methods.description: Type guard to check if an element is a linear element.

methods.name: isLineElement
methods.description: Type guard to check if an element is a line.

methods.name: isArrowElement
methods.description: Type guard to check if an element is an arrow.

methods.name: isElbowArrow
methods.description: Type guard to check if an arrow element is elbowed.

methods.name: isSimpleArrow
methods.description: Type guard for sharp or curved arrows, not elbowed.

methods.name: isSharpArrow
methods.description: Type guard for sharp arrows without roundness.

methods.name: isCurvedArrow
methods.description: Type guard for curved arrows with roundness.

methods.name: isLinearElementType
methods.description: Checks if a given element type is 'arrow' or 'line'.

methods.name: isBindingElement
methods.description: Type guard to check if an element is a binding element (like an arrow).

methods.name: isBindingElementType
methods.description: Checks if an element type is a binding element type ('arrow').

methods.name: isBindableElement
methods.description: Type guard to check if an element can be bound, like rectangles, ellipses, images, etc.

methods.name: isRectanguloidElement
methods.description: Type guard for elements that are rectangles, diamonds, images, iframes, etc.

methods.name: isRectangularElement
methods.description: Type guard for elements that are rectangular or similar shapes.

methods.name: isTextBindableContainer
methods.description: Type guard for containers that can hold bindable text elements.

methods.name: isExcalidrawElement
methods.description: General type guard to check if an object is an Excalidraw element.

methods.name: isFlowchartNodeElement
methods.description: Type guard for flowchart node elements like rectangle, ellipse, diamond.

methods.name: hasBoundTextElement
methods.description: Checks if an element has bound text elements.

methods.name: isBoundToContainer
methods.description: Checks if an element is bound to a container.

methods.name: isArrowBoundToElement
methods.description: Checks if an arrow element has start or end bindings.

methods.name: isUsingAdaptiveRadius
methods.description: Checks if a shape type uses adaptive radius.

methods.name: isUsingProportionalRadius
methods.description: Checks if a shape type uses proportional radius.

methods.name: canApplyRoundnessTypeToElement
methods.description: Determines if a roundness type can be applied to an element based on its type.

methods.name: getDefaultRoundnessTypeForElement
methods.description: Returns default roundness type for an element based on its shape.

methods.name: isBounds
methods.description: Type guard to check if an object is a Bounds array.

methods.name: getLinearElementSubType
methods.description: Determines the subtype of a linear element (sharp, curved, elbow).

methods.name: isValidPolygon
methods.description: Checks if a set of points can form a polygon (more than 3 points and closed).

methods.name: canBecomePolygon
methods.description: Checks if points can be turned into a polygon.
